docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-19-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUN-02-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF DARWIN MENDOZA IS PRESENT AND ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER PILAR ESPINOZA (#330288). DEFENDANT CHERRY KYAUK IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS BENITA SELOR (STATE FARM INSURANCE). PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT WHEREBY DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF $5,490.80 (INCLUDED COURT COSTS). PARTIES AGREE TO COORDINATE TO MEET MONDAY TO SIGN THE RELEASE AND PROVIDING THE PAYMENT AT 5:15 PM AT PLAINTIFF'S EMPLOYMENT LOCATION, ADDRESS AND CONTACT NUMBERS EXCHANGED. PROGRESS REPORT SET FOR JUNE-02, 2023 AT 3:30 P.M. IN DEPT 506. IF THERE IS NO APPEARANCE BY ANY PARTY, THEN CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE ("DWP"). IF THERE IS AN APPEARANCE, HEARING WILL BE CONDUCTED FOR JUDGEMENT DECISION. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
